metric_definitions.embedding_collapse_score: (Mean off-diagonal cosine of up to 2048 seed-42 sampled real-item embeddings + 1)/2. Null means fewer than two sampled real-item embeddings. 0.5 corresponds to mean cosine zero. Directional alignment alone does not establish collapse, poor recommendation diversity, or prediction quality; zero vectors follow F.normalize semantics.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_mean: Mean raw positive-minus-negative logit over valid distinct training pairs; score-scale dependent.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_p10: Nearest-rank tenth percentile of raw sampled training-pair margins.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_neg_beats_pos_rate: Fraction of valid sampled training pairs with negative logit strictly higher.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_small_margin_rate: Fraction of valid sampled training pairs with raw margin < 0.5; scale dependent.
metric_definitions.margin_valid_positions: Exact number of real, distinct candidate training pairs used for margin summaries. Rows containing invalid history IDs are excluded. Zero count yields null margin summaries; nonfinite valid scores raise an explicit error.
metric_definitions.pos_neg_margin_category_breakdown: Category lists remain empty because category metadata is unavailable; total counts describe valid sampled training positions only.
metric_definitions.history_sensitivity: Last position with sequence>0 and positive>0 per row; real distinct fixed positive/negative IDs; at least four real history items. Pairwise win is 1/0/0.5 for win/loss/tie. k=min(3,floor((n-1)/3)). Composite controls remove k newest or oldest items. Recent-nonfinal removes the k positions immediately before the final item; earlier_matched removes k uniformly sampled positions from the disjoint preceding region. final_deleted removes the final position; earlier_single removes one uniformly sampled nonfinal position. Five random controls are averaged within each row, using a local seed-42 generator. Suffix lengths 2/4/8/16/n are clipped and deduplicated in that order; suffix_full always denotes the complete original history, while other suffix names give the actual retained length. Condition counts can therefore differ. All histories retain their original external width and chronological order. Mean deltas are intervention-minus-original; direct paired differences subtract the matched earlier control. Cosine distances are reported separately, average valid draws within rows, and exclude only zero-norm cosine comparisons. Final-position retention differs from final-item-ID change when histories contain repeats. Execution checks use one eligible history; null checks mean no observation. The baseline explicitly initializes each GRU call at zero but processes leading padding. Deletion effects therefore confound padding and context; recency conclusions are withheld. No user intervals or four-category macro intervals are estimated from anonymous rows. These are descriptive training-prefix sensitivity measurements, not held-out HR@10, evidence of intent, proof of harmful shortcut use, or improvement estimates.
